## 有趣用法和干货
1. **Addy Osmani: how the Claude Code team does code review when Claude writes ~90% of the code**: from June to September merged PRs more than doubled while the revert share fell 40%+. The setup: pre-PR verification (make Claude show runnable proof, then a fresh-context subagent reviews the diff), a Claude review on every PR with multi-agent bug hunts and voting to cut false positives, a blocking security review, CI, human approval tiered by a risk classifier (agent approvals never count; re-approve after untrusted commits), merge queue + flags + staged rollout, and fast rollback. Lessons: cap review cycles at three (one PR looped 50+ times overnight; ~59% of re-flags were old code), use incident PRs as the reviewer's eval set, and keep humans for "should we build this", dangerous code, architecture and ownership. 8,800+ bookmarks. https://x.com/addyosmani/status/2114604912520921136 · 全文 Full text: [site](https://naijoug.github.io/dailyai/article/addy-osmani-claude-code-code-review/) / [md](../../articles/addy-osmani-claude-code-code-review.md)
> **[zh]** **Addy Osmani：Claude 写了约 90% 代码时，Claude Code 团队怎么做代码评审**：6 月到 9 月合并的 PR 翻倍多，回滚占比降了 40% 以上。做法：提 PR 前先验证（让 Claude 拿出可运行的证据，再由全新上下文的子 Agent 审 diff）；每个 PR 都有 Claude 评审，多 Agent 并行找 bug 并投票压误报；可阻断的安全评审；CI；按风险分类器分级的人工批准（Agent 批准永远不算，不可信提交后要重新批准）；合并队列 + 功能开关 + 分阶段发布；快速回滚。经验：评审最多三轮（曾有 PR 一夜循环 50 多次，约 59% 的重复标记是老代码），用引发事故的 PR 当评审员的评测集，人负责「该不该做」、危险代码、架构和担责。8800+ 收藏。
2. **poteto's takeaways from Yaron Minsky's talk on making your codebase agent-friendly**: agents thrive on feedback and types are one of the best kinds; make illegal states unrepresentable so types enforce global rules; use property-based tests, fuzzing, even full-system deterministic simulation; expect tests (print and capture output) make behavior legible and shrink review surface; and formal methods change ROI — seL4 took ~25 person-years with 23 lines of proof per line of C, but agents make that cheaper. 1,800+ bookmarks. https://x.com/poteto/status/2114626630429913383 | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rUYP4C29yCw
> **[zh]** **poteto 总结 Yaron Minsky 演讲：如何把代码库改造得更适合 Agent**：Agent 靠反馈成长，类型是最好的反馈之一；让非法状态无法表示，类型就能在全库强制全局规则；用基于属性的测试、模糊测试，乃至全系统确定性模拟测试；expect test（把输出打印出来并固化进测试）让行为一目了然、缩小评审面；形式化方法的投入产出也变了——seL4 花了约 25 人年，每行 C 配 23 行证明，而 Agent 让这件事便宜得多。1800+ 收藏。
3. **Paul Iusztin's free course: learn harness engineering by building Claude Code from scratch**: after taking apart Claude Code, OpenCode and Pi, he published an open-source Python course (8 articles, 6 videos, 1 codebase) covering harness design, the bare agent loop, local/remote sandboxing, four context-engineering techniques, subagents, headless deploys (CLI, webhooks, cron), benchmarks and replaying failed runs. > **[zh]** **Paul Iusztin 免费课程：从零写一个 Claude Code 来学 harness 工程**：拆解 Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Pi 之后，他发布了开源的 Python 课程（8 篇文章、6 个视频、1 个代码库），涵盖 harness 设计、最简 Agent 循环、本地/远程沙箱、4 种上下文工程技巧、子 Agent、无头部署（CLI、webhook、cron）、基准评测和回放失败运行。由 Modal、Opik 和 Kitaru 赞助。
4. **Bruce Van：恶意 AGENTS.md 能劫持编程 Agent，三条自查**：Forever Security 报告称，用恶意 AGENTS.md 测试时 Codex 超过 90% 中招、Claude Code 约一半（研究人员自测），结论是没有漏洞可修——Agent 只是照着说明文件干活。自查：不在「下载」「桌面」这类杂物目录里启动 Agent；刚 clone 的仓库和别人发的压缩包，先自己看一眼 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md；检查 `~/.codex/config.toml` 里有没有不认识的 mcp_servers。https://x.com/bruc3van/status/2114669805580235247 | https://forever.security/blog/hijacking-ai-agents-via-downloads-folder/
> **[en]** **Bruce Van: malicious AGENTS.md files can hijack coding agents — three self-checks**: Forever Security reports that in its own tests with a malicious AGENTS.md, Codex fell for it over 90% of the time and Claude Code about half the time, concluding there is no bug to patch — the agent just follows the instruction file. Checks: don't launch agents in junk folders like Downloads or Desktop; inspect AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md in freshly cloned repos and archives others send you; check `~/.codex/config.toml` for unfamiliar mcp_servers.
